answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and moors a skiff at a wharf berth on a trellis. After filings close, a random peer auditor from another row re-measures its lift log in the lagoon. A fake log or copied lift burns the bond; a passing auditor loses 25 credits. First 40, kth 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,537,500, plus 70,000 locked. A swap ring fails: auditors are drawn after filing. Honest operators pay 40 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
